checked.ref: controls-10-setup-config-1 (and Season setup / Reset the season, verdict dead)
checked.claim: Reset the season in Season setup closes the window and never opens the reset, and no other road starts a reset.
checked.why: The press sets resetAsked and calls dialog.close(); drpgWindow returns DialogV2.wait(config) with no close option of its own and the window passes rejectClose: false, so a close with no button resolves null (the module's own model of it: the harness shim's 'dismissed (rejectClose: false -> null)', and live.mjs's note that close() resolves the opener's wait). Line 1214 returns null on !result before 1215 reads resetAsked; End the chapter works only because 1213 reads its flag first. Other roads looked for: git grep of resetSeason / season-wipe.mjs imports over scripts/ outside tests finds only the facade re-export (season-setup.mjs:74) and the call at :1215; the GM panel's tile is gone (gm-panel.mjs:305-308, a comment); api.mjs reaches openSeasonSetup only (api.mjs:814); module.mjs imports offerStartHere alone. The tests that name it are source-text regexes (tests-tier1.mjs:20350, 20693-20694: they pin that the line exists, not that it is reached); every scenario and tier-2 test calls resetSeason() directly, never through the button. Severity: the season's only reset door does nothing, said to nobody - major holds.

checked.claim: Season setup's Save writes all six clock fields and the safeword as drawn at open, undoing a time step, a trial started or another GM's change made meanwhile.
checked.why: The window has no live option and nothing closes or redraws it: git grep of 'drpg-window-season' outside tests finds only its own alreadyOpen and classes lines; closeOpen is called for two other classes only (murder-rules.mjs:3637, 4607); no updateSetting / clientSettingChanged hook in scripts/ touches it. readSeasonForm spreads readClockForm, which reads every field from the form (gm-campaign.mjs:82-93); applyCampaignForm asks only on a chapter change and on entering the Class Trial (:308-334) and then writes the whole patch through setClock (:347-361), which merges the patch over the clock as it stands (clock.mjs:157-158 'const next = { ...before, ...patch }'), so a drawn value wins over a newer one. Leaving the Class Trial asks nothing, and reconcilePhase from classTrial ends the floor, shuts the vote and runs executeAtExit (clock.mjs:999-1034). The safeword is compared with the setting at Save, not with the value drawn (season-setup.mjs:1255). No test was found pinning the opposite. Severity: an ordinary GM action (stepping the clock with a setup window open) is undone without a word, and the owner's redraw rule (D-A1) is not met by this surface at all - major holds.

checked.claim: A Monocub invitation or Bribe window stays open after the invitation is withdrawn or the offer is answered or lapses, and its Accept is then refused.
checked.why: receiveCubs only deletes the actor from invitationsShown when the copy no longer holds the invitation (monocub.mjs:322-323); it closes nothing. Neither 'drpg-cub-invite' nor 'drpg-cub-bribe' is named anywhere in scripts/ outside its own window (git grep), and closeOpen is called for two other classes only. cancelMonocubOffer patches the row and closes no window (:441-446). answerMonocubOffer answers null with no open invite (:457), and the bridge row monocub.answer is answer 'reply' (bridge-table.mjs:600-606), so the player is told a refusal; the sheet's panel draws its own Accept and Refuse for the same offer (sheet-actions.mjs:363-384). Minor holds: a particular timing, refused and told, nothing wrong written.
